scripts.text:
[Roberto]
Ooh, you're from my home town!
Nice to see you!
How are you?
Ah! That arrow!
You made it, didn't you!
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
噢，是老乡啊！
真高兴见到你！
最近怎么样？
啊，那支箭！
是你自己做的吧！

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
Haha...!
Do you think it's a lot better?
Haha... anyways, I am glad.
Come back with once in a while
with news from home.
Then byebye~
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
哈哈...!...！
是不是好用多了？
哈哈...总之，真高兴。
有空回来看看，带点家乡的消息吧。
那就再见啦~

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
Eh!
 
You are...
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
咦！
 
你是...

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
You brought them!
Thank you very much.
Then, as I promised, I will teach you the skill.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
你都带来了啊！
真是太感谢了。
好，说到做到，我这就教你。

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
No need to worry about arrows now.
Oh, and did you happen to see
someone called Jason in Payon?
Be careful. He is a
ferocious one.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
现在不用为箭矢发愁了。
对了，你在斐扬见过一个叫杰森的人吗？
小心点，那家伙可凶了。

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
You just have to be careful of Jason in Payon.
Remember.
Then bubye~ Thank you for the presents~
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
记得小心斐扬的杰森啊。
那就拜拜啦~
谢谢你带来的礼物~

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
An archer in Morocc!?
Nice to see you! Meeting a fellow
archer in a place like this! *sniffsniff*!
I came alone to Morocc..
but I was a newcomer, and the pressure... waaah~
I was very lonely~
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
在梦罗克竟然能遇到弓箭手！？
真高兴哇哇~
在这种地方还能碰见同行，*吸鼻子吸鼻子*！
我一个人来到梦罗克...人生地不熟，压力又大...呜哇~
我好孤独啊~

scripts.text: It must be hard. It's ok have faith.
scripts.translation: 一定很辛苦吧，振作点

scripts.text: Keep suffering.
scripts.translation: 继续受苦吧

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
Yes. Thank you...
You must be having a hard
time in a place like this.
Isn't it hard to find arrows?
That's why I make my own.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
嗯，谢谢你...
在这种地方，你一定也很不容易吧。
箭矢很难弄到，对不对？
所以我都是自己做。

scripts.text: Eh, really?!
scripts.translation: 咦，真的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
Yeah! I gather different items
and make arrows using them.
It is a useful skill to help me
survive alone in this tough world.
If you'd like, I can teach you.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
对！
我收集各种材料，用它们制作箭矢。
靠着这门实用的本事，我才能独自在这个艰难的世界里活下去。
你要是想学，我可以教你。

scripts.text: That would be wonderful.
scripts.translation: 那太好了

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
But.. I can't do it for free.
Nothing is free in this world~
Mmm... How about this?
You bring me what I ask for.
Then I will teach you the skill.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
不过...可不能白教。
这世上哪有免费的东西嘛~
嗯...这样吧？
你帮我找些东西，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
I've been very lonely since I left my hometown.
I would like to treat my homesickness
with things from there.
Bring me 20 Resins from the trees in the 
Payon forest, and 1 Red Potion
sold in the store.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
离开家乡后，我一直很孤独，想找些家乡的东西解解乡愁。
帮我带20个斐扬森林树木上的树脂，还有商店里卖的红色药水1瓶。

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
Also, 13 Trunks from the Willows that
live near the Payon Forest,
41 Pointed Scale,
7 Mushroom Spores.
If you bring me all of these,
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
还需要这些：
斐扬森林附近树精身上的树干13个
鳞片梗41个
香菇芽孢7个
只要你把这些都带来，

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
I will teach you the skill.
Then.. I'll be waiting.
For news from our home.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
我就教你这项技能。
那...我就在这里等你，等你带来家乡的消息。

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
...hey {0}.
...be careful at night.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
...喂，{0}。
...晚上可要小心啊。

scripts.text:
[Roberto]
Hmm... Do you
have something to say?
I have nothing.
Difference in levels
cuts off conversations.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯托]
嗯...你有什么想说的吗？
我倒是没什么可说的。
等级差得太多，实在聊不到一起啊。

scripts.text:
[?]
Eh... First time seeing an archer or something?
Just go where you were going.
I only talk to high level archers.
Won't open my mouth otherwise!
scripts.translation:
[?]
呃...怎么，没见过弓箭手啊？
该干嘛干嘛去。
我只跟高等级的弓箭手说话，其他人免谈！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Eh, we meet again.
Ehhhh so weird.
Whenever I see someone again
I start eh-ing a lot.
Ehhh... anyways nice to see you again.
Ehhhh... don't come any more ehh...
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
哎呀，我们又见面了。
嗯...好奇怪。
每次见到熟人我就开始“哎呀”个不停。
哎呀...总之很高兴再见到你。
哎呀...别再来了啊...

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Darn... my wound isn't healing.
Bleh.. I was too careless... 
to become like this.. err...
But still, hurting me like this
giving me so many injuries...
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
可恶...伤口怎么还没好。
啧...都怪我太大意，才落到这步田地...呃...
可是，居然把我打成这样，弄得浑身是伤...

scripts.text:
What should I do about Roberto.
Mmmm... Ah!
You? How long have you been there?
Mmm... very high level.
Someone like you would definitely be
able to know how to use Arrow Repel.
scripts.translation:
罗伯托那家伙，该拿他怎么办呢...
嗯...啊！
你？在那儿多久了？
嗯...等级挺高嘛。
像你这样的，肯定知道怎么用冲锋箭吧。

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text: Teach me.
scripts.translation: 教我

scripts.text:
[Jason]
...you're kidding, right?
Oh my, you don't even know
Arrow Repel at that level?
You're a strange person.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
...你在开玩笑吧？
都这等级了，居然还不知道冲锋箭？
你可真是个怪人。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
(Jason was in the lala land.)
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
(杰森在发呆。)

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Well, ok. I'll teach you what
Arrow Repel is.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
好吧，我就告诉你冲锋箭是什么。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Arrow Repel is a skill that allows you to
push the opponent away as soon as you attack.
You can only use it when you aim exactly
at the target. But unlike magic, 
it doesn't de-spell.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
冲锋箭能在攻击的同时将对手击退。
必须准确瞄准目标才能施展，不过它不像魔法那样会被打断。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
It is very useful for an archer
that is weak in close ranges.
If you would like to learn,
come find me again.
There are some necessary materials.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
对不擅长近战的弓箭手来说，这招很实用。
想学就再来找我，不过得准备些材料。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
First, because you must modify a bow
bring a crossbow you do not use.
10 Tentacles, 10 Bill of Birds,
3 Yoyo Tails.. these are very elastic.
Also, 2 Emeralds. And last but not least...
36 bottles of Banana Juice that I love!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
首先，得改造一下弓，带把不用的十字弓来。
还要触手10个、鸟喙10个、溜溜猴尾巴3个...这些都很有弹性。
再加上绿宝石2个。
最后，最不能少的就是...我最爱的香蕉汁36瓶！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
......Ehem!
If you bring all of these,
I shall teach you Arrow Repel.
Then, see you again.
(I'm going to be mad if you don't bring the Banana Juice.)
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
...咳！
这些都带齐了，我就教你冲锋箭。
那就回头见。
（要是不带香蕉汁来，我可是会生气的。）

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Ok! Perfect!
I shall teach you the nationally
renowned skill, Arrow Repel!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
好！齐了！
我这就教你名扬全国的冲锋箭！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Oh, works better than I expected!
Won't be needing to modify the bow!
You can take this back~
And enjoy using your newly inherited
skill in fields and dungeons!
He~heh~!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
哦，效果比想象中还好！
不用改造弓了，你拿回去吧~
尽管到野外和地下城里试试新学的技能吧！
嘿~嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Mmm... too bad.
You are missing some things.
Once again, you need 2 Emeralds,
3 Yoyo Tails, 10 Tentacles,
10 Bill of Birds, and last but
not least 36 bottles of Banana juice!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
嗯...可惜，还缺东西。
再说一遍，要绿宝石2个、溜溜猴尾巴3个、触手10个、鸟喙10个。
还有最不能少的香蕉汁36瓶！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Make sure you have all of them and come again!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
把东西带齐了再来！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Ooh... you are an archer.
If you try a little more
you will have a great
reputation as an archer!
Exert yourself!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
哦...是弓箭手啊。
再努力些，你一定能成为名声响亮的弓箭手！
加把劲吧！

scripts.text:
[?]
What does life need from
a lonely lad like me?
scripts.translation:
[?]
生活究竟想从我这孤独的小伙子身上得到什么呢？

scripts.text:
[???]
Errrrrrr...
